current_point.claim: 提出了一种基于图摘要的大规模时序图表示学习方法GSAERU中的图表征学习模块，该模块利用图摘要技术对原图快照进行压缩，并将压缩后的新图输入图自编码器，通过重构误差训练原图节点的表征，从而高效处理大规模动态图的表征学习。
current_point.claim_en: Proposed a graph representation learning module in GSAERU, a large-scale sequential graph representation learning method based on graph summarization, which compresses the original graph snapshot using graph summarization technology, feeds the compressed graph into a graph autoencoder, and trains node representations via reconstruction error, efficiently handling representation learning on large-scale dynamic graphs.
technical_features: 将动态时序图建模为各时刻原图快照的序列
在单时间步上将图快照输入图表征学习模块
通过图摘要技术对原图进行压缩
将压缩后的新图输入图自编码器
利用与原图的重构误差训练原图节点的表征
technical_features_en: Model the dynamic sequential graph as a sequence of snapshots at each time step
Input the graph snapshot into the graph representation learning module at a single time step
Compress the original graph through graph summarization technology
Feed the compressed graph into a graph autoencoder
Train the representations of original graph nodes using reconstruction error with the original graph

current_task.description: Final valid evidence cards for NP-1 are insufficient (0/1 required). Conduct an additional English literature search to find works that compare or overlap with the GSAERU graph representation learning module that compresses large-scale dynamic graph snapshots via graph summarization and trains a graph autoencoder with reconstruction error. Focus on identifying related methods that use graph sketching/summarization for efficient dynamic graph representation learning, or that combine graph summarization with autoencoders for large graph embedding.
